app.settings.performance.fast-loading.de.message: Makes navigating the launcher feel much faster. Loaded data is kept fresh for several minutes instead of being refetched every time, cached results live far longer, the launcher stops reloading everything when the window regains focus, and pages you have already visited stay in memory so going back to them is instant.

app.settings.performance.fast-loading.tr.message: It uses more RAM (visited pages and cached data stay loaded) and content such as mod lists can be up to a few minutes out of date until you refresh. It does not speed up starting the launcher or launching Minecraft itself — those are handled outside the interface.

app.settings.performance.free-memory.des.message: Immediately drops everything the launcher has cached from the network — mod lists, search results, project pages. The memory is released right away and anything still on screen loads again when needed.

app.settings.performance.hero.descriptio.message: Decide how the launcher spends memory, graphics power and background time. Every switch takes effect immediately.

app.settings.performance.pause-hidden.de.message: While the launcher window is minimised or hidden, stop the timers that poll for running instances and pause the particle effects. Nothing you can see is affected, and everything resumes the moment you come back.

app.settings.performance.skin-quality.de.message: How sharply the 3D skin preview is rendered in the Skin selector and the skin editor. Higher settings render the model at several times the screen resolution and scale it back down (supersampling), which makes even single skin pixels crisp — at the cost of GPU work while a preview is on screen.

app.settings.performance.skin-quality.st.message: Ultra 4x draws 16x the pixels, so instead of redrawing that every frame the preview switches to on-demand rendering: a frame is produced only when something changes — while you drag to rotate, or when the skin or cape changes. You get the sharpest possible model for almost no continuous GPU load; in exchange the idle sway animation holds still.

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.analy.message: No download, play time or server-join reporting

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.geo.message: No location lookup from your IP address

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.ident.message: Anonymous identity: no system, e-mail or install ID is sent

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.links.message: Links and files from outside never install or start anything without asking

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.logs.message: Shared logs anonymized: IP addresses, player names, account IDs, tokens and your user folder are hidden

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.no-hi.message: No connection history is kept — blocked requests are simply dropped

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.scann.message: Mods checked for known malware before every launch

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.token.message: Sign-in tokens stored encrypted on your system

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.track.message: Trackers, analytics, ads and telemetry blocked

app.settings.privacy.shield.always.updat.message: Updates only from Minekube, checked against its signature

app.settings.privacy.shield.logs-cleanup.message: Game logs and crash reports keep server addresses, chat and player names. Older ones are deleted automatically shortly after the launcher starts.

app.settings.privacy.shield.logs-deleted.message: {count, plural, =0 {No logs to delete} one {Deleted # file} other {Deleted # files}}

app.settings.privacy.shield.mods-note.message: Needs Fabric, Quilt, Forge or NeoForge. On servers that require signed chat, No Chat Reports may keep you from chatting.

app.settings.privacy.shield.mods-text.message: Before each launch, adds the open-source mods No Telemetry (stops Minecraft’s telemetry to Microsoft) and No Chat Reports (makes your chat messages unreportable) to modded instances, and removes them again when you turn this off. A copy you installed yourself is left alone.

app.settings.privacy.shield.strict-text.message: Also cuts the launcher off from the online library (browsing, search, updates), log analysis and third-party image services. Microsoft sign-in and the game files keep working. Add mods yourself from files while it is on.

app.settings.privacy.shield.text.message: Every connection the launcher makes is checked before it leaves your computer. Analytics, error reporting, ads and telemetry never get through — not even a DNS lookup.

app.settings.privacy.v2.data-text.message: Instances, worlds, settings and accounts are kept in the launcher folder. Automatic database backups sit next to it, in case something ever goes wrong.

app.settings.privacy.v2.discord-text.message: Shows on your Discord profile that you are playing Minecraft through Minekube Launcher. Off means Discord sees nothing from the launcher. Takes effect after a restart.

app.settings.privacy.v2.open-source-text.message: Every line of the launcher is public under the GNU GPL-3.0 licence, so anyone can verify these promises — and the launcher can never be closed off.

app.settings.privacy.v2.sign-in-text.message: Microsoft sign-in happens directly between you and Microsoft; the launcher never sees your password. The sign-in tokens it keeps are stored encrypted on your system and never handed to the launcher’s interface. Local accounts never sign in anywhere.

app.settings.privacy.v2.text.message: No tracking, no ads and no account of our own. What the launcher knows about you lives on this computer, and you decide what leaves it.

app.settings.profile.v2.accounts-text.message: The active account is the one every game starts with. Switch with one click; adding and removing accounts lives in the sidebar.

app.settings.profile.v2.local-note.message: Minekube Launcher has no account of its own and no cloud profile. Your profile is simply your Minecraft accounts plus the settings and instances stored on this device.

app.settings.profile.v2.signed-out-text.message: Add a Microsoft or local account in the sidebar under “Playing as” to start playing.

app.settings.pvp.fair-text.message: Only quality-of-life and visual improvements that large PvP servers allow. No reach, no aim assist, no X-ray — nothing that could get your account banned.

app.settings.pvp.feature.combat.text.message: Hit colors, cleaner particles, low fire, toggle sprint and sneak, and zoom — the small things that decide close fights.

app.settings.pvp.feature.hud.text.message: Keystrokes, CPS, FPS and ping, armor durability, potion timers and a custom crosshair — each one movable and resizable.

app.settings.pvp.feature.performance.tex.message: A tuned set of optimization mods for steady frame times during fights, even on modest PCs.

app.settings.pvp.feature.profiles.text.message: Separate layouts for Bedwars, Skywars, duels or UHC, switched with one click and synced across all your instances.

app.settings.pvp.step.one.text.message: One switch, here in Settings. Nothing to install by hand.

app.settings.pvp.step.three.text.message: Open the overlay in game with a single key and arrange your HUD. Turning the client off removes everything again.

app.settings.pvp.step.two.text.message: Before each launch it adds the PvP mods that match the instance’s game version and loader, and keeps them up to date. Vanilla instances get a loader automatically.

app.settings.pvp.text.message: In the spirit of Lunar Client and Feather Client — but as a Minekube extension that lives inside your own instances. Turn it on once and the launcher downloads, configures and keeps up to date everything a serious PvP player needs. No separate client, no account, no subscription.

app.settings.pvp.title.message: A competitive client, built right into the launcher

app.settings.replay-introduction.descrip.message: Revisit the two-step introduction to launcher language and the features that help you get into your next world.

app.settings.visual.advanced-animations..message: Full control over the animated loading screen: the wordmark and how it moves, the progress indicator, the starfield and nebulae around it, the particles drifting in the background and the timing of the whole sequence.

app.settings.visual.animations.descripti.message: Enable or disable all animations and transitions in the launcher. Turning them off can help on very weak hardware.

app.settings.visual.character.cost.message: It is a real 3D view, so a small WebGL canvas keeps drawing while the launcher is visible. It is rendered small at a modest resolution and stops completely while the window is hidden. On a weak GPU it is the first thing worth turning off.

app.settings.visual.character.descriptio.message: Shows your own Minecraft character in the bottom right corner once you are signed in. It waves hello, follows your mouse pointer with its whole body and wanders around its corner. Nothing is shown while no account is signed in.

app.settings.visual.character.reactions-.message: The character answers what you do: it carries a gear while this window is open, hops with a tick when you switch something on and shakes its head when you switch it off, cheers when a game launches and reads along on project pages. In quiet moments it has a repertoire of its own, keeps still while you are busy and gets sleepy late at night.
Let the character react to you

app.settings.visual.effect-style.aurora-.message: Slow ribbons of luminous colour flow beneath the interface.

app.settings.visual.effect-style.cubes-d.message: Glowing Minekube blocks drift through a soft three-dimensional space.

app.settings.visual.effect-style.descrip.message: Every effect is drawn in a lightweight canvas layer with depth, soft lighting and carefully limited particle counts. Select a scene to preview it across the launcher.

app.settings.visual.effect-style.embers-.message: Warm sparks rise and flicker like a quiet portal flame.

app.settings.visual.effect-style.firefli.message: Quiet, floating lights pulse softly in the distance.

app.settings.visual.effect-style.galaxy-.message: A spiralling starfield with layered parallax and a glowing nebula.

app.settings.visual.effect-style.lightni.message: Brief, branching bolts light up a stormy sky without obscuring text.

app.settings.visual.effect-style.snow-de.message: Fine winter flakes drift at different depths across the scene.

app.settings.visual.effects.description.message: An animated atmosphere behind every screen. The scene is drawn on one lightweight canvas that thins itself out on slower hardware, never covers text and pauses whenever the launcher is hidden.

app.settings.visual.enhanced.description.message: One motion system for the whole launcher: page changes, dialogs, menus, hover and press feedback all share the same timing, built only from smooth, GPU-friendly movement.

app.settings.visual.glow.description.message: Lights up headings, labels, buttons and switches with a soft Minekube glow. It is static light, so it costs nothing while the launcher runs.

app.settings.visual.glow.galaxy-descript.message: Wraps every button and switch in a slowly turning ring of galaxy colours. Works with or without the glow and holds still when animations are off.

app.settings.visual.splash.animation-spe.message: Multiplies every loading screen animation, from the drifting nebulae to the shine.

app.settings.visual.splash.background-ef.message: Drift the particle effect you picked in Visual behind the loading screen, so both share one atmosphere.
The background only shows the starfield and the nebulae.
The background uses the “{style}” effect from Visual.

app.settings.visual.splash.grid-floor-hi.message: The retro floor grid stretching out below the logo.

app.settings.visual.splash.logo-animatio.message: How the Minekube wordmark moves while the launcher loads.
The wordmark slowly swells and settles again.
The wordmark drifts gently up and down.
The wordmark softly pulses with light.
A band of light sweeps across the wordmark.
The wordmark turns slowly in three dimensions.

app.settings.visual.splash.logo-glow-hin.message: The halo and the light that surrounds the wordmark.

app.settings.visual.splash.logo-intensit.message: How far the wordmark travels and how strongly it reacts.

app.settings.visual.splash.logo-size-hin.message: Scales the wordmark and the glow behind it.

app.settings.visual.splash.min-display-h.message: Keeps the loading screen up for at least this long so it never just flashes by.

app.settings.visual.splash.preview-hint.message: Everything below is drawn live, exactly as the launcher will show it.

app.settings.visual.splash.progress-styl.message: How loading progress is drawn underneath the logo.

app.settings.visual.splash.replay-hint.message: Shows the real loading screen with your current settings for a few seconds. Click anywhere or press Escape to skip it.

app.settings.visual.splash.show-message-.message: Prints what the launcher is doing right now under the indicator.

app.settings.visual.splash.style.bar-hin.message: A glowing gradient bar with a travelling shine.

app.settings.visual.splash.style.dots-hi.message: A quiet row of lights that fill up as work completes.

app.settings.visual.splash.style.minimal.message: A hairline that grows across the middle of the screen.

app.settings.visual.splash.style.ring-hi.message: A circular dial with the exact percentage in the middle.

app.settings.visual.splash.style.segment.message: Blocky Minecraft-style chunks that light up one by one.

app.settings.visual.studio.description.message: Shape the atmosphere with fluid motion, dimensional light and crisp, readable surfaces. Your choices preview instantly and stay in sync across the launcher.

app.settings.visual.style.arcade-desc.message: Bold, blocky steps inspired by the worlds you play.

app.settings.visual.style.cinematic-desc.message: Dramatic entrances with layered depth and a gentle glow.

app.settings.visual.style.description.message: Choose the character of the launcher’s movement. Every profile updates the live preview and shared interface transitions.

app.settings.visual.style.playful-desc.message: Springy feedback, lively icons and satisfying little rebounds.

app.settings.visual.style.smooth-desc.message: Silky, balanced motion with gentle depth and a soft landing.

app.settings.visual.style.snappy-desc.message: Quick, precise transitions that get out of your way.
